newsitem.title: JORDAN: Israeli Foreign Minister Levy in Jordan for talks.
newsitem.headline: Israeli Foreign Minister Levy in Jordan for talks.

text.p: Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy arrived in Jordan on Thursday for talks with King Hussein and Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti.
Witnesses said Levy was met at Amman airport by Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Khaled al-Madadha.
He was due to head straight for talks with Kabariti, who on Wednesday accused Israel of creating conditions for a "human catastrophe" by failing to implement fully its accord with Palestinians.
Kabariti said Israeli expansion of settlements in the West Bank also threatened final status talks with Palestinians and posed a direct threat to Jordanian stability.
